name: Movement speed, jump, pickup range, knockback airtime and fall damage
status: Confirmed (MeowDB states it was measured/confirmed in COT2)
status_note: We measured COT2 video footage closely, frame by frame, and got these results.

climb_speed.note: Ropes and ladders use the climb speed. Haste raises both.

speed_notes: Speed above 140 does nothing. Speed also has no effect on how fast you attack.
MapleStory Classic World adds 20 Speed behind the scenes, so your 100 moves like the old 120.
jump_note: At Jump 100 you rise 77 px. Each point of Jump adds launch speed, so height grows a little faster than Jump itself.
nimble_feet_note: Nimble Feet (every class) +10 - Beginner skill; lasts 10 to 30 sec; 3 min cooldown
pickup_lines: x: 25 px left to 25 px right
y: 60 px above to 30 px below
controls_statements: Do you also know that if you press the down arrow key, you can crouch, and then jump while crouching, to leap down to a lower platform?
If you press the up arrow key in front of a portal, you can enter it, and if you press the up arrow key in front of a ladder or rope, you can climb or hang from it.
controls_note: Rain's Maple Quiz 1 (quest 1013) NPC dialogue: crouch (down) + jump drops through to a lower platform; up enters a portal or grabs a ladder/rope. Qualitative only; key bindings are configurable in game.

knockback_airtime.status: MeowDB's Model (MeowDB's own model of the mechanic; not a confirmed game constant)
notes: An ordinary knockback gives about 0.27 seconds of airtime when you start on the ground and land at the same height, with normal gravity and no further impacts or obstacles.
This is a physics estimate. Existing movement, ledges and special attacks can change the flight. It does not measure how long you lose the ability to attack.
gaps: Horizontal knockback speed/distance for the player is not documented.
Whether every hit knocks the player back (or only hits above some threshold) is not documented.

monster_knockback.definition: Being pushed backward when hit. Also the knockback resistance stat on mobs: a mob with 500 KB needs 500+ damage to stagger.
gaps: Monster knockback distance/speed is not documented. The stagger duration is published per monster, not as a formula: each live monster page shows STAGGER ("How long the mob is staggered for when knocked back."), carried by monsters/<id>.json stagger_ms with its capture (tools/meowdb/captures/monster_<id>.*).

fall_damage.status: Published formula (no status label on the MeowDB card)
lines: N = consecutive movement updates with downward speed ≥ 500 px/s
notes: For a qualifying landing in COT2, base fall damage starts at 24 and caps at 36. The counter resets when downward speed falls below 500 px/s; N measures consecutive fast-falling updates. Taller drops generally increase it.
A flight-map setting multiplies it by 100, but none of the 426 checked COT2 maps enable that setting.
DEF, avoidability, level and max HP do not enter this base formula. Final HP loss and mitigation from defensive skills remain unconfirmed.
gaps: The length of one "movement update" (tick rate) is not documented.
Walking acceleration/deceleration and air control are not documented.
